subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

She groaned at the memory, suffering all over again the __excruciating__ embarrassment of those moments
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"excruciating"** means something that is intensely painful, either physically or emotionally. (बेहद पीड़ादायक)

 
 
• **Example:** The **excruciating **pain in his leg made it impossible for him to walk.
 
 
 
• The word **"painful"** refers to something that causes discomfort, distress, or suffering. (दर्दनाक)
 
 
• **Example:** It was a **painful **experience to recall those difficult moments from the past.
 
 
 
• Since the context of the sentence describes embarrassment and suffering, "painful" is the most appropriate synonym for "excruciating."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Excited** (उत्तेजित): Feeling very enthusiastic and eager.

 
 
• **Example:** She was excited to start her new job.
 
 
 
• **Justified** (सही ठहराया गया): Having a valid reason or explanation for something.
 
 
• **Example:** His anger was justified after being treated unfairly.
 
 
 
• **Rational** (तार्किक): Based on reason or logic.
 
 
• **Example:** He made a rational decision after carefully analyzing the situation.
 
 

3a:Tacc,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
